g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to check eligibility for the Earned Income Tax
Credit: From household type to asset criteria
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-10
Determine the household type first
The income criteria vary by household type.
Income criteria: Check combined total
income for the couple
The income requirement is based on whether the
couple's combined annual total income is below
the threshold for their household type.
Asset criteria: The total value of
assets, not market price
The asset requirement is based on whether the
total value of the homes, land, buildings,
passenger vehicles, rental deposits, financial…
Check exclusion categories and the
application period
Even if you meet the requirements, you cannot
apply if you do not have Korean nationality
(with some exceptions), are another resident's…
